title: Sweet and Spicy Yellow American Peel Pie
description: A kid-friendly American dessert featuring mixed peel, lamination-puff, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Roll out the lamination puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, whisk together the granulated sugar, brown sugar, eggs, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
Add the melted butter, mixed peel, and confectioners' sugar to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Spread the sugar mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the 1-inch border over the filling to form a crust and press the edges to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 40 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350°F (175°C) and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Dust the pie with confectioners' sugar before serving.
